added.title: Director, HVAC and Hotel Equipment
added.description:
Dual-functioning role over HVAC and Hotel Tech Equipment. Create and implement all actions needed for the HVAC team to become a center of excellence in equipment mx, operating profile and energy consumption. Develop structure and processes for hotel tech equipment team to maintain equipment reliability standards.

Lead, develop, and foster growth of the team to further develop skillset for HVAC managers, galley/laundry/open deck amenities managers, and crew. Optimize our SOP to continually improve ship safety, crew and guest safety, environmental footprint and energy consumption.

Essential Functions:

Provide strategic oversight of HVAC and assigned hotel technical assets across the fleet, including asset inventory, configuration management, equipment standards, and lifecycle governance. Serve as the technical authority for the evaluation, approval, and implementation of equipment modifications, upgrades, and replacements, ensuring compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, classification society rules, and operational objectives. Develop, maintain, and approve technical specifications, engineering standards, and equipment design criteria to ensure consistency, reliability, and long-term asset performance across the Carnival Cruise Line fleet.
Establish and continuously improve asset reliability programs for HVAC and assigned hotel technical equipment through criticality-based maintenance strategies and lifecycle management principles. Develop and maintain equipment maintenance philosophies that align maintenance activities with operational risk, equipment criticality, and business objectives. Oversee periodic reviews of preventive maintenance programs, annual inspection processes, and equipment condition assessments to ensure maintenance effectiveness and regulatory compliance. Monitor fleetwide technical performance metrics, including equipment availability, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), leveraging data-driven insights to improve asset reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance investment.
Lead the development and implementation of fleetwide HVAC operational standards and best practices that optimize system performance, energy consumption, guest comfort, and environmental sustainability. Establish standard operating procedures and operational profiles that maximize efficiency while ensuring safe and reliable equipment operation. Identify opportunities to reduce energy usage, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and support corporate sustainability goals through equipment optimization, technology implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Drive operational accountability through performance monitoring, reporting processes, and oversight of shipboard HVAC leadership teams.
Direct the development and execution of maintenance, dry dock, capital expenditure, and long-term asset replacement plans for HVAC and assigned hotel technical assets. Manage departmental budgets and approve repair, maintenance, dry dock, and capital expenditures within established authority levels. Oversee procurement strategies, including the development of scopes of work, requests for quotation, bid evaluations, contractor selection, and contract award processes, ensuring compliance with corporate governance standards. Ensure all technical plans, projects, and modifications receive appropriate approvals from regulatory authorities, classification societies, flag administrations, and other governing bodies while delivering projects safely, efficiently, and within budget.
Provide strategic oversight of galley, laundry, and open deck amenity assets to ensure reliability, operational readiness, and lifecycle performance across the fleet. Partner closely with Culinary, Hotel Operations, Supply Chain, and shipboard leadership teams to ensure critical equipment is properly maintained, supported by effective spare parts programs, and available to meet operational demands. Lead and develop technical managers and support teams responsible for maintenance execution, equipment condition monitoring, inventory management, and operational reporting. Foster strong collaboration between shipboard and shoreside stakeholders to identify operational challenges, prioritize solutions, and improve service delivery.
Lead fleetwide technical initiatives, innovation programs, and cross-functional projects that enhance equipment performance, operational efficiency, and guest experience. Represent Carnival Cruise Line in industry working groups, technical committees, and collaborative forums to support the advancement of HVAC and hotel asset technologies and industry best practices. Provide subject matter expertise for newbuild specifications, equipment selection, and design reviews by incorporating lessons learned, operational experience, and fleet performance data into future vessel designs. Coordinate resources, stakeholders, and project teams to successfully execute strategic initiatives within established timelines, budgets, and performance objectives.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Scope: The role operates as a fleet-wide technical authority for HVAC and Hotel Equipment, with impact spanning both shipboard operations and shoreside asset management. Responsible for defining and implementing maintenance, operational, and performance standards across all vessels to ensure safety, reliability, and energy efficiency. Contributes to and influences Dry Dock planning, Capex investments, and long-term asset strategies (LTAP), ensuring alignment with broader Technical Asset and Marine Operations objectives. Drives consistently across the fleet by integrating processes, reporting cadence, and governance structures between ship and shore organizations. Supports strategic priorities including energy optimization, environmental footprint reduction, and operational excellence, positioning HVAC and hotel systems as critical enablers of business performance.
Problem solving: Addresses complex, multi-variable challenges involving equipment reliability, energy consumption, and operational constraints across diverse vessel configurations and operating profiles. Requires data-driven analysis of performance trends, maintenance outcomes, and failure modes to identify root causes and implement sustainable improvements. Balances operational urgency vs. long-term asset integrity, making decisions that impact safety, guest experience, and cost efficiency. Anticipates and mitigates risks related to equipment failures, dry dock execution, and system performance, often under time-critical and resource-constrained conditions. Develops practical solutions through cross-functional collaboration (technical, operations, procurement, and finance), aligning stakeholders with differing priorities.
Impact: Sets and enforces fleet-wide technical standards for HVAC and hotel equipment, directly influencing asset reliability, operational continuity, and safety outcomes. Drives measurable improvements in energy consumption, environmental compliance, and cost control, contributing to corporate sustainability and financial objectives. Ensures critical hotel and back-of-house systems availability, protecting guest experience and operational delivery across all vessels. Impacts both short-term operational performance (uptime, responsiveness) and long-term asset lifecycle optimization (maintenance strategy, Capex prioritization). Acts as a key contributor to the transformation toward a more structured, performance-driven technical asset organization.
Leadership: Leads a team of HVAC and Hotel Equipment managers and specialists, building technical capability, accountability, and continuous improvement culture. Provides functional oversight to shipboard teams and traveling supervisors, ensuring consistent execution of standards across the fleet. Manages and influences budgets related to R&M, Capex, and Dry Dock activities, ensuring effective prioritization and cost governance. Exercises cross-functional leadership across Technical, Marine, Hotel Operations, Procurement, and Finance teams, often without direct authority. Drives clarity in roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations through structured governance, reporting, and SOPs.

Essential/Minimal Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Advanced knowledge of HVAC, refrigeration, and hotel technical asset systems, including lifecycle management, reliability engineering, maintenance strategies, and operational performance optimization.
Demonstrated project and program management expertise, including dry dock, capital investment, equipment modernization, and fleetwide improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of cruise ship regulatory requirements, classification society standards, flag state regulations, and applicable environmental compliance requirements.
Knowledge of asset management principles, maintenance methodologies, and equipment criticality assessment processes.
Strong financial and business acumen with experience managing operating budgets, capital expenditure, and long-term asset investment plans.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change across shipboard and shoreside environments.

Essential Experience Required:

10 years of progressively responsible experience managing HVAC, refrigeration, marine engineering, hotel technical assets, or related systems within the cruise, maritime, hospitality, industrial, or large-scale facilities industries.

Travel: 25-50% with shipboard travel likely

Work Conditions: Work may require employee to work inside and/or outside with exposure to changing climate and/or operate machinery.

Physical Demands: Requires regular movement throughout company facilities.

This position is classified as “in-office.” As an in-office role, it requires employees to work from a designated Carnival office in South Florida Monday through Thursday each week. Employees may work from their homes on Fridays. Candidates must be located in (or willing to relocate to) the Miami/Ft. Lauderdale area.

Offers to selected candidates will be made on a fair and equitable basis, taking into account specific job-related skills and experience.  

At Carnival, your total rewards package is much more than your base salary. All non-sales roles participate in an annual cash bonus program, while sales roles have an incentive plan. Director and above roles may also be eligible to participate in Carnival’s discretionary equity incentive plan. Plus, Carnival provides comprehensive and innovative benefits to meet your needs, including:

Health Benefits:
Cost-effective medical, dental and vision plans
Employee Assistance Program and other mental health resources
Additional programs include company paid term life insurance and disability coverage 

Financial Benefits:
401(k) plan that includes a company match
Employee Stock Purchase plan

Paid Time Off
Holidays – All full-time and part-time with benefits employees receive days off for 8 company-wide holidays, plus 2 additional floating holidays to be taken at the employee’s discretion. 
Vacation Time – All full-time employees at the manager and below level start with 14 days/year; director and above level start with 19 days/year.  Part-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 84 hours/year.  All employees gain additional vacation time with further tenure.
Sick Time – All full-time employees receive 80 hours of sick time each year.  Part-time with benefits employees receive time off based on the number of hours they work, with a minimum of 60 hours each year.  

Other Benefits
Complementary stand-by cruises, employee discounts on confirmed cruises, plus special rates for family and friends
Personal and professional learning and development resources inc

added.title: VP of Engineering
added.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're hiring a VP of Engineering to take full ownership of one of our core engineering domains. You'll report to our CTO and own your domain outright, including strategy, architecture, delivery, and the team. This is a hands-on leadership role.

Responsibilities

Take full technical and delivery ownership of a core area of the business, which could span AI, trading, retail, or another part of the platform
Architect and build the core systems in your domain, from real-time generation and demand modelling through to high-volume consumption pipelines and the customer-facing app
Build and lead the engineering team in your domain, including hiring, structure, and standards
Set technical direction alongside the CTO and the wider leadership team
Ship alongside your team on the hardest problems

Requirements

Demonstrable excellence as an IC
Proven track record of building complex systems that run in production
Experience leading engineering teams while remaining hands-on
Comfort operating with a wide scope and little structure, and the judgment to decide what gets built and what doesn't
Clear communication with engineers, product, and commercial stakeholders

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs
Private health insurance
Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

updated.title: Director Engineering, Internal IT
updated.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

The Director of Engineering, Internal IT is a senior engineering leader responsible for shaping and implementing the technology strategy that keeps Etsy’s global workforce productive, connected, and enabled to do their best work. This is fundamentally an engineering role where you will apply your IT knowledge to lead engineers and managers who build, automate, and continuously improve the internal systems, platforms, and tooling that Etsy employees depend on every day.

You will be at the forefront of how Internal IT reimagines itself through automation and AI enablement by reducing repetitive work, and building intelligent systems that scale with Etsy’s business. Where others see a support function, you see a platform engineering opportunity and a connective backbone for how the company operates across identity, access, SaaS, internal tooling, and employee enablement. You will set the vision, build the roadmap, and manage your team to deliver enterprise-grade internal tooling and infrastructure that is reliable, secure, and substantially ahead of what employees expect.

Reporting into the VP of Engineering, CISO, you will partner closely with Security, Product and G&A to align internal technology investments with company priorities. You will lead managers and senior ICs, set the strategic direction for your functional area, and serve as a key voice for the Internal IT function across Etsy’s broader Engineering organization.

This is a full-time position reporting to the VP of Engineering, CISO.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Internal IT Engineering team builds and operates the Etsy systems that power how Etsy works ranging from endpoint management and SaaS platform automation to access workflows, productivity tooling, and enterprise integrations. The team thinks like software engineers first: they write code, build automations, design scalable architectures, and measure their impact.
The team spans IT Operations and IT Engineering, with a growing focus on AI enablement of finding opportunities to embed intelligent tooling into internal workflows to reduce manual overhead and improve the employee experience at scale. Engineers here are scrappy and creative, proud of the outsized impact a small, high-craft team can have across a company of thousands. Collaboration is central to how the team operates. You’ll work asynchronously with teams across time zones, partner with Security on compliance and endpoint posture, and engage with the engineering team to ensure Internal IT is a first-class participant in the company's broader technical community. We value honest feedback, clear communication, continuous learning, and a genuine investment in each other’s growth.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Setting and leading a multi-year IT strategy with a real standpoint — not just operational continuity, but a specific perspective on where the function is going, including AI enablement, build-versus-buy principles, employee experience goals, and translating that vision into actionable team priorities.
Leading and developing a team of engineering senior ICs and managers, across diverse skills, providing coaching, performance feedback, and career growth investment across the organization.
Driving a culture of engineering excellence by establishing standard processes, promoting automation over manual toil, reducing technical debt, and ensuring the team builds systems that are maintainable and scalable.
Identifying and leading AI enablement opportunities in Internal IT, partnering with the our Engineering and Product teams to define how intelligent tooling can improve internal workflows, automate repeatable tasks, and surface better insights for employees.
Building and maintaining deep cross-functional relationships with stakeholders in Security, People, Finance, Legal, and Workplace to understand their operational needs and ensure IT systems meet compliance, privacy, and business requirements.
Owning the IT budget and vendor relationships for your function or in support of other functions, handling operating expenses, participating in contract negotiations, and making sure the team is equipped with the right tools to meet current and future needs.
Defining, tracking, and reporting on core metrics — automation coverage, ticket resolution, employee satisfaction, infrastructure performance, token efficiency — and using data to drive continuous improvement.
Serving as an escalation point and executive sponsor for major incidents, infrastructure migrations, and high-stakes IT initiatives across the company.
Recruiting, onboarding, and retaining diverse, top engineering talent, and aiding in Etsy Engineering’s broader hiring and culture efforts.
Participating in Engineering-wide working groups and giving to the direction of Etsy Engineering at large not just as a leader within Internal IT, but as a stakeholder in how the broader function operates.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

10+ years of experience in IT or engineering roles, with at least 4–5 years in a senior engineering leadership position leading managers and multi-disciplinary teams - ideally with direct exposure across support/helpdesk operations, platform or systems engineering, and SaaS or enterprise tooling functions..
Deep technical fluency across enterprise infrastructure, SaaS platform engineering, endpoint management, identity and access management, and IT automation with the capability to engage meaningfully in architectural discussions and technical trade-offs.
Proven experience leading AI enablement and automation initiatives where you’ve reduced operational toil through engineering, not just process, and you have a point of view on where AI can most meaningfully change how an internal IT organization operates.
A track record of developing engineering leaders, investing in your team, giving honest feedback, and creating conditions where people grow.
The ability to balance big-picture strategy with operational precision to guide the architecture decisions that make or break your team’s ability to implement it.
Strong cross-functional influence skills of building trust with partners in Security, Finance, People, and Legal without requiring authority, and you can communicate technical strategy to non-technical stakeholders clearly and credibly.
A genuine curiosity about what motivates your team, stakeholders, and users through a leadership style built on empathy, candor, and follow-through.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 280,000.00 - 378,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 252,000.00 - 340,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

updated.title: VP, Functional Design Engineering
updated.description:
Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Functional Design Engineering is where enterprise architecture intent becomes shippable Terraform. At LPL, you'll partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and FinOps to translate big-picture designs into opinionated, well-architected reference patterns that engineers actually build. If you'd rather spend your time turning architects' diagrams into code, ADRs, and proof-of-concept platforms — and want a senior leadership role where you're as comfortable in a design review as you are in a pull request — this is your seat.

Job Overview:

As the VP, Functional Design Engineering, you lead the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and engineering teams and pods across CCOE to translate enterprise architecture intent into implementable, well-architected, code-driven solutions. You take high-level designs from architects and produce detailed, opinionated, build-ready engineering specifications aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework and LPL's standards. You also curate the cross-CCOE reference pattern library — domain-tagged Terraform module bundles, reference architectures, anti-patterns, and architecture decision records (ADRs). LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You are both a people leader for a small, senior team across the US and LPL's India GCC and a hands-on senior engineer who produces reference patterns, code, and proof-of-concept builds when ambiguity is highest.

Responsibilities:

Lead the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod within the Foundations team in CCOE; partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, the other Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and the Platforms, Containers, Support, and Delivery teams to translate enterprise architecture intent into implementable, well-architected, code-driven solutions
Take high-level designs from architects and produce detailed, opinionated, build-ready engineering specifications aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework and LPL standards
Define and curate the cross-CCOE reference pattern library: domain-tagged Terraform module bundles, reference architectures, anti-patterns, and architecture decision records (ADRs)
Partner closely with the Principal Engineer, Cloud Strategy Lead so that tooling, IaC, and self-service platform strategy stay aligned with enterprise design direction
Lead design reviews, architecture review boards, and engineering deep-dives across all five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the four peer Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Network Engineering, Monitoring)
Champion the application of the AWS Well-Architected Framework across all six pillars (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability) and drive measurable improvements against each
Hands-on contribute to reference patterns, Terraform modules, and proof-of-concept builds, especially in the highest-ambiguity areas where engineering is still discovering the right answer
Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
Embed agentic AI capabilities into the design function: AI-assisted pattern generation, automated Well-Architected reviews, ADR drafting, cross-pattern impact analysis, and MCP-backed agents that surface existing patterns to internal customers
Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain a globally distributed team of senior cloud engineers across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC)
Own all people-management responsibilities for the pod including hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, performance management, compensation planning, career development, and certification-path execution per the CCOE certification matrix
Operate as a player-coach: spend meaningful time hands-on in Terraform code, design reviews, peer reviews, and incident response while leading people and delivery
Lead and personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as senior incident commander and technical escalation point for the pod
Partner with peer VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the leaders of the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the leaders of the pods within Foundations (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to align roadmaps and remove cross-team and cross-pod blockers
Champion AWS Well-Architected Framework adoption across all six pillars and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
Contribute to and curate the private Terraform module library that powers self-service infrastructure for application teams, including module standards, versioning, deprecation, and contribution patterns
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and partner with the RTE and PMO on delivery commitments and dependencies
Represent the pod in executive forums, architecture review boards, internal audit, and customer engagements; communicate technical risk and trade-offs to non-technical executives

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:

10+ years of progressive technical experience including 5+ years in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering leadership; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
5+ years of hands-on production AWS at scale in a multi-account landing zone, with 4+ years of authoring production Terraform in a private module ecosystem delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
5+ years experience as a direct people manager of engineering teams of 5+ engineers, including hiring, performance management, compensation, and difficult personnel decisions
5+ years experience leading and personally participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations in a fast-paced, security-conscious, regulated environment (financial services strongly preferred)
5+ years experience translating enterprise architecture intent into implementable engineering designs that downstream engineers actually build, with deep, current command of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and excellent technical writing (ADRs, design documents, reference architectures)

Core Competencies:

Operates as the credible "translator" between architects and engineers — equally at home in both rooms
Strong systems-thinking across security, network, container, data, finance, and developer experience before recommending a path
Bias for shipping reference patterns and code — not slideware
Calm, opinionated, and evidence-driven in design conversations
Player-coach who is comfortable in code reviews, architecture sessions, and people 1:1s in the same day
Continuous learner, especially in cloud-native, IaC, platform engineering, and applied AI
Sets vision and translates ambiguous strategy into executable engineering roadmaps
Bias for self-service, automation, and reducing toil for downstream internal customers
Builds high-trust relationships across the US and India organization and across functions (Architecture, Security, FinOps, Application Engineering, Network, Audit)
Calm, decisive incident commander; fosters a strong post-incident learning culture
Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority
Thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, regulated environments with imperfect information

Preferences:

Experience as an internal architecture review board member or equivalent design-authority role
AWS Certified Security - Specialty (preferred for security-aligned design reviews)
AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate or Data Analytics - Specialty (preferred for data-aligned design reviews)
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or MBA
Experience building, scaling, or leading globally distributed engineering teams across the US and India / GCC
Experience integrating agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) into platform, IaC, and engineering practice
Strong scripting / programming proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
AWS Solutions Architect - Professional
AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Associate
HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004) or Authoring & Operations
Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
Open-source contributions, public technical writing, or conference speaking on cloud, IaC, or platform engineering topics
Experience with Backstage or another Internal Developer Platform (IDP)
Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management at scale

Pay Range:

$149,350.00 - $248,848.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

updated.title: Sr Software Development Manager- Remote
updated.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

BeyondTrust is seeking a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the team driving the evolution of the NHI Governance domain within our Pathfinder products. You will build, grow, and lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for delivering a new platform-native module and the scalable, secure, and extensible services that power our SaaS offerings; helping customers discover, assess, and remediate non-human identities (service accounts, workload identities, secrets and keys, and AI agents) across cloud and on-premise environments. This role blends people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical judgment: you will set the bar for execution and quality while developing engineers and partnering across product, design, and platform teams to solve complex identity and security challenges at scale.

What You’ll Do

Experience leading and managing software engineering teams building cloud-based or SaaS products.
A strong technical foundation, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture, design, and code-level trade-offs.
Experience leading teams that use AI-assisted, agentic development tools such as Claude Code, and foster their effective and responsible adoption.
Proven track record of delivering complex projects on schedule and at a high-quality bar.
Experience partnering with product and design in an agile delivery environment.
Familiarity with modern cloud-native development, microservices, and public cloud providers (AWS preferred).
Experience developing engineers and growing talent through coaching and mentorship.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to drive clarity and direction amid ambiguity.
Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and business needs across cross-functional teams.

Nice To Have

Domain experience in identity security: IAM, NHI/Secrets, cloud IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID), OAuth/OIDC.
Experience delivering multi-tenant shared platform services consumed by other engineering teams.
Experience leading a team through a 0-to-1 module or domain build.

Who You Are

A people-first leader who takes ownership of team outcomes and grows engineers.
A bar-raiser for delivering results and relentlessly pursuing high quality.
Someone who balances technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making, ensuring security without unnecessary complexity.
A strong communicator, able to bridge technical and business needs in cross-team and cross-functional discussions.
A builder of healthy, inclusive, high-trust teams.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

updated.title: Senior Director, Strategic Operational Technology
updated.description:
United States, Walkersville (Maryland)

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The Senior Director of Operational Technology (OT) is a pivotal leadership role that requires a proven professional with both strategic acumen and deep technical expertise to drive transformative initiatives across the Business Unit's (BU) operational technology landscape.

This role requires a senior leader to define and execute an OT strategy aligned with BU and platform priorities, leveraging emerging technologies—including AI—to drive efficiency and innovation. The Senior Director will oversee complex OT programs end‑to‑end while leading and developing the Bioscience OT team. Strong financial acumen is essential, including ownership of technology budgets, cost analysis, and ROI evaluation for major initiatives.

Success in this role depends on strong cross‑functional collaboration with IT, Operations, and Global Centers of Excellence to deliver fit‑for‑purpose solutions that achieve operational excellence. The ability to operate effectively within a matrix environment—aligning diverse stakeholders through clear communication, negotiation, and strategic focus—is critical to ensuring holistic, enterprise‑aligned transformation outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the OT strategic roadmap aligned to BU vision, enterprise goals, and regulatory requirements.
Provide thought leadership on OT best practices, emerging technologies, and AI adoption to drive efficiency and business outcomes.
Define and implement a robust OT governance framework, including policies, standards, risk management, and compliance for biotech operations.
Lead and oversee complex OT transformation programs, ensuring strong program governance, stakeholder engagement, and on‑time delivery.
Drive process improvement, technology implementation, and organizational change across site, BU, and global initiatives.
Manage technology budgets, resources, and performance metrics, including forecasting, ROI evaluation, and prioritization of high‑impact initiatives.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing IT/OT organization, acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

Key Requirements

15+ years of experience in FDA‑regulated, GMP environments, preferably within Pharma/Biopharma manufacturing.
Bachelor’s degree in IT/OT or related field, with strong preference for Biopharma IT focus.
Deep technical expertise in OT systems, manufacturing technologies, and emerging OT trends.
Proven leader of large‑scale digital and OT transformation initiatives in regulated environments.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and the technologies that enable them.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes and influence senior stakeholders.
Visionary people leader with a strong track record of building, developing, and inspiring high‑performing OT teams, including practical experience leveraging AI.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

updated.title: Director, Information Security Office Consultant
updated.description:
At Capital One, you will help consult on initiatives, programs, and projects to raise their game in Information Security and Risk Management.
You are pragmatic and practical in your understanding of risk and security, but also willing to lean into solutions or know when to pull in additional experts and or escalate. You collaborate and innovate with other teams within Capital One to push the envelope. You are comfortable with technologies like Cloud services, Containers, Docker, Microservices, Serverless, APIs, DevOps, micro-segmentation, Customer Servicing platforms and technologies security, generative AI security, PCI and other business and regulatory cybersecurity compliance frameworks. Security is essential to what we do here, from protecting our customers to our associates.

Responsibilities:

Act as a central point of contact for your line of business to the rest of Capital One’s Information Security and Risk Management
Coordinate and execute proactive Information Security consulting to the business and technology teams covering Infrastructure Platform Security, Application Security, Resiliency, Data Security, Network Architecture and Design, and User Access Management
Serve as an expert in Capital One’s Information Security capabilities, architecture solutions, policies, procedures and standards
Influence customers to leverage security capabilities and solutions to shift and integrate security to the left in the development processes
Partner with enterprise cyber, tech and product security teams to provide technical and cybersecurity architectural leadership, where necessary to drive innovative solutions that help improve security
Escalate and manage cyber security risk
Provide ad hoc support on special Information Security hot topics for the business
Provide regular updates to executive leadership with your line of business on the overall Information Security health and risk environment
Work with line of business leadership to anticipate their objectives and needs to better serve the line of business

About You:

You have a desire to work in a very fast moving, forward leaning, and modern computing environment
You have a deep passion for Securing modern computing platforms
You have a strong desire to continually learn about new technologies
You possess strong conceptual thinking and communication skills
You are able to work well under minimal supervision
You are a demonstrated leader with team-oriented interpersonal skills and the ability to interface effectively with a broad range of people and roles, including upper management, IT leaders, and technology vendors
You maintain calmness and clarity of thought under pressure and ability to maintain confidentiality
You have a deep understanding of strategic business objectives and the ability to drive results toward those objectives

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree
At least 7 years of experience in cybersecurity or information technology
At least 5 years of people leadership experience
At least 5 years of experience performing security risk assessments and security architecture reviews
At least 5 years of experience in Application Development

Preferred Qualifications:

7+ years of experience providing guidance and oversight of security concepts
Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Engineering
5+ years of experience building software utilizing public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
5+ years of experience with cloud security strategy, architecture and engineering
2+ years of experience securing customer servicing agents platforms
2+ years of experience in securing Generative AI platforms and applications
2+ years of experience with Agile methodologies
2+ years of experience with Application Security, Threat Modeling, Penetration Testing or Vulnerability Management
3+ years of experience integrating SaaS products into an Enterprise Environment
2+ years of experience with securing container services
2+ years of financial services industry experience
Professional certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect and Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
2+ years of experience in Offensive or Defensive Security techniques
Experience in cybersecurity, privacy, or technology industry standards (ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF and 800 series, GLBA, GDPR, FFIEC, or PCI-DSS)
